request.style: English, female contralto, solo with choir, piano, cello, harp, organ, solemn, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Peter walked through the night
To the home of Mary
Many had gathered there
To pray without ceasing

[Verse]
He knocked on the outer door
A servant girl came
Her name was Rhoda
She heard his voice clear

[Verse]
She was overjoyed
She did not open the gate
She ran inside quickly
To tell them all true

[Verse]
Peter was standing outside
The gate remained shut
The joy was too great
To stop at the door

[Outro]
Mary's house was the place
Where prayer did not end
